actions.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Committee on Energy and Natural Resources Subcommittee on Public Lands, Forests, and Mining. Hearings held. With printed Hearing: S.Hrg. 119-237.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. (text: CR S4317-4318)

subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects members of the public who submit comments on Bureau of Land Management rules and regulations.
dimensions.evidence: only considering public comments from U.S. citizens

dimensions.assessment: Imposes administrative changes on how public land rulemakings collect feedback.
dimensions.evidence: establish and implement a process commonly known as `Completely Automated Public Test to tell Computers and Humans Apart (CAPTCHA)'

dimensions.assessment: No significant federal spending or revenue impacts are stated or implied.
Amends the Federal Land Policy and Management Act of 1976 regarding rulemaking and public involvement definitions.
dimensions.evidence: Section 103(d) of the Federal Land Policy and Management Act of 1976 is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent change to how the Bureau of Land Management administers public involvement processes.

missing_information: Cost estimates for implementing CAPTCHA systems across the Bureau of Land Management
importance_detail.rationale: The bill alters public comment rules for the Bureau of Land Management by limiting comments to U.S. citizens and requiring CAPTCHA tests to block AI bots.
